mapper.update: UPDATE voucher_reversal_operation SET version=#{version},status=#{status},attempts=#{attempts},highest_revision=#{highestRevision},state_json=#{stateJson},updated_at=#{updatedAt},next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt},lease_until=#{leaseUntil} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND input_json=#{inputJson} AND command_digest=#{digest} AND active_operation_id=operation_id AND retired_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM voucher_reversal_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM voucher_reversal_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND active_operation_id=#{id}
SELECT state_json FROM voucher_reversal_operation_revision WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND reversal_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
SELECT * FROM voucher_reversal_retirement WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND reversal_id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM voucher_reversal_retirement WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND operation_id=#{original} ORDER BY retired_at,id
mapper.update: UPDATE voucher_reversal_operation SET active_operation_id=NULL,retired_at=#{retiredAt} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{reversalId} AND version=#{stoppedVersion} AND active_operation_id=#{operationId} AND retired_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.trace_id,business.business_no,submitted.process_instance_id FROM voucher_reversal_operation q LEFT JOIN voucher_operation origin ON origin.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND origin.id=q.operation_id LEFT JOIN approval_application business ON business.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND business.id=origin.application_id LEFT JOIN approval_submission_round submitted ON submitted.tenant_id=business.tenant_id AND submitted.application_id=business.id AND submitted.round_no=origin.round_no WHERE q.retired_at IS NULL AND ((q.status IN ('QUEUED','UNKNOWN') AND q.next_attempt_at<=#{nextAttemptAt}) OR (q.status IN ('POSTING','QUERYING') AND q.lease_until<=#{leaseUntil})) ORDER BY COALESCE(q.next_attempt_at,q.lease_until),q.created_at,q.id LIMIT 10
